How Are You Joining?

Join a Team

Can’t find your confirmation email, invitation, or team code? Check your Junk or Spam folder. If the email is there, mark it as Not Junk and return here to continue.

Scan the team QR or enter the team code. You fill out the information and the coach simply approves or denies the request.

Accept a Private Invitation

Use your organization, athlete, parent/guardian, or coach/staff invitation here.

Joining organization leadership?
Ask an organization administrator to invite you from Organization → Leadership invitations. Use the invited email; no team or athlete profile is required.

For a team coaching role, ask its administrator for an invitation from Clipboard → Edit Team Leaders.

Create Your First Team

Starting your own program? Create your organization and team here. You’ll manage the team from your personal account.

Use an existing organization when you have administrator access. Otherwise, ask its administrator to add you, or create your own organization below.

CHALLENGES & WRESTLE-OFFS

Match Book

Match setup

Difference is measured against the lighter athlete. Both must make the class plus allowance. Suggestions use weights recorded in the last 24 hours; confirm age, experience and applicable rules before wrestling.

Confirm your event's scoring and period rules before starting. The scorer records your decisions; it does not automatically award penalties, decide ties, or end on a technical fall.

HUMAN REVIEW

Safety Review

Automatic flags help a coach or administrator find concerning language. They do not replace human judgment or emergency procedures.

What should I choose?Reviewed — checked; no further action is needed.Dismiss — a false alert or a test.Escalate — a real concern needing follow-up.Ending a Guardian Safety Test clears its test-only alerts automatically while preserving the audit history.

Sign-In & App Security

These settings protect this device without changing team permissions.

🔐
Checking device security…Face ID, Touch ID, or the phone passcode can protect your saved session.
Your Profile PIN

Set one 4–8 digit PIN for this profile on this device. Use it for app unlock, weigh-in kiosk and Mat Mode. Other devices have their own PIN. Changing it requires your current PIN.

No app PIN is set.

Face ID Sign-In

Sign in after logging out with Face ID or Touch ID. This also enables app lock when you reopen the app. Enable this only on your personal device.

Your login is saved in this device’s protected Keychain and can be read only after biometric authentication. It does not sync to other devices. Password sign-in and email recovery remain available.

App lock protects an already signed-in session. Optional biometric sign-in protects a saved login in this device’s Keychain. Password recovery uses your verified account email.
